name: Separate bookmark exploration from current-tab navigation
statement: Users explore a bookmark through a disclosure control showing its available representative image above associated content, return without losing context, or visit its URL through the title in the current tab.
requiredProperties: Right triangle becomes left return arrow
Available representative images visible by default
Do not fabricate Chrome bookmark notes or tags
Preserve permission boundaries and native bookmark identity

provenance.sourceReference: Owner discussion 2026-10-16: arrow explores image above associated items and becomes left return arrow; bookmark title updates current tab; show available images by default
